title.rendered: Nils Lofgren: Wreck on the Highway

content.rendered:
Today’s Bruce cover is close to home: From the tail end of the E Street Diaspora comes this gorgeous Nils Lofgren cover of “Wreck on the Highway.”

Originally recorded for a Bruce tribute album in 1997, it was re-released on Nils’ Face the Music box set a few years back.

Nils’ vocals suit the song, but for my money the highlight is Nils’ take one the long guitar outro. This is easily a repeat-listen cover.

© January 25, 2018

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Nils Lofgren: Man at the Top
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Nils Lofgren has performed "Man at the Top" live more often than Bruce has--it's a song that clearly means a lot to him.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Goin’ Back
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: When Carole King attended Bruce's show at The Roxy in 1975, Bruce paid tribute by covering her wistful classic, "Goin' Back."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Not Fade Away
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce covered "Not Fade Away" as far back as 1971 and as recently as last summer. It's always at the ready for an impromptu team-up--watch some of best ones inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Janey, Don’t You Lose Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: One of Bruce's lightest but truest songs of love and friendship, "Janey, Don't You Lose Heart" is an instant highlight wherever she turns up.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Let It Be Me
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Frequently sound checked but never performed, the unabashedly romantic "Let It Be Me" seemed perfectly suited for the Tunnel of Love Tour.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Jump
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Twice only: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band cover one of the greatest rock anthems of the 1980s.
